description: Components an app bundles, such as restic, rclone or yt-dlp. A patch merges once CI is green, a minor or major waits for a live test, and component-update.yml opens an issue when one needs work. Extend this after base.json, so these rules come after its groups.

customManagers.description: A '# renovate: datasource=<d> depName=<name>' line right above the ARG or ENV that holds the version. versioning= and extractVersion= may follow. A GitHub release is written without its leading v, which the build adds back where it needs one.

packageRules.description: Every component gets a PR of its own, outside the Go and npm groups.
Go libraries an app is built around, which a release names like a bundled tool.
A component patch or digest refresh merges once every check is green.
A component minor or major stays open until it has run on the test instance.
prBodyNotes: This moves a bundled component by a minor or major version. Run it on the test instance before merging.
